issue.title: [A+] Unit tests: Prepare Offline service/query modules
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Part of **A+ Test safety net**. Prepare Offline **UI/hooks** are tested; **service/query modules** are not.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Untested (or thinly tested): `prepareOfflineDownload.ts`, `prepareOfflineResources.ts`, `queries.prepareOffline.ts` (confirm exact paths in PR).

**Expected:** Colocated unit tests for download/queue/inventory logic used by Prepare Offline + Resources gate.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Unit tests for the three service/query modules above
- One PR is OK (same feature vertical) — do **not** mix with UI redesign

**Out of scope**
- New Prepare Offline product features
- Device download QA (covered by existing Needs-QA tickets)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each listed module has meaningful unit coverage (happy + at least one failure/empty path)
- [ ] Engineering-only — no Needs QA

## Verification / test plan

1. Targeted jest for prepare-offline service tests
2. Full `npm test -- --ci`

## Separation note

If the PR exceeds ~reviewable size, split by module into follow-ups — prefer shipping all three if small.

## Links

- Related closed product work: #39, #51, #53, #192, #201
